SELECT /* 서비스실행사업 목록조회 */ T1.SRVC_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_BIZ_NO /* 서비스사업번호 */ , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /* 서비스실행사업명 */ , T1.BIZ_BGNG_YMD AS BIZ_BGNG_YMD /* 사업시작일자 */ , T1.BIZ_END_YMD AS BIZ_END_YMD /* 사업종료일자 */ , T1.BGT_EXCN_AMT AS BGT_EXCN_AMT /* 예산실행금액 */ , T1.ALTMNT_GROUP_LCLAS_SE_CD AS ALTMNT_GROUP_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 배정그룹대분류구분코드 */ , T1.EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD AS EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD /* 실행사업분류구분코드 */ , T1.APLY_BGNG_YMD AS APLY_BGNG_YMD /* 신청시작일자 */ , T1.APLY_END_YMD AS APLY_END_YMD /* 신청종료일자 */ , T1.REQSTD_INDCT_YN AS REQSTD_INDCT_YN /* 신청서표시여부 */ , T1.NTCN_YMD1 AS NTCN_YMD1 /* 알림일자1 */ , T1.NTCN_YMD2 AS NTCN_YMD2 /* 알림일자2 */ , T1.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CTPV_CD AS CTPV_CD /* 시도코드 */ , T1.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD /* 시군구코드 */ , T1.INST_NO_CN AS INST_NO_CN /* 기관목록 */
, (SELECT LISTAGG(INST_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY INST_NM) FROM SAA000 A WHERE A.INST_NO IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(T1.INST_NO_CN, '[^,]+', 1,ROWNUM) FROM DUAL CONNECT BY ROWNUM < LENGTH(REGEXP_SUBSTR(T1.INST_NO_CN, '[^,]+')) + 1) AND DEL_YN = 'N') AS INST_NO_NM /* 기관명 목록 */
, T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ FROM SDA420 T1 /* 서비스실행사업 */ WHERE T1.SRVC_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_BIZ_NO} ORDER BY T1.USE_YN DESC, T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT DESC
